goal: 100% means a completed playable PSP recompilation across the agreed original-game scope, not generated-code coverage.
scope_note: The original PSP feature/mode inventory must be explicit before final acceptance; no original mode is silently excluded. Future optional PC enhancements are not original-game completeness requirements.
known_blockers: The rest of the campaign and original feature/mode scope are not validated.
Required PSP service semantics remain incomplete or unaudited; source-name bindings are insufficient evidence.
Dense driving scenes have reported drops toward 20 FPS and unstable frametimes.
A known code/data candidate and dynamic callback coverage still need review.
